articles.title: LEGAL-UQA: Testing Constitutional Question-Answering Systems for Urdu Speakers with a Parallel English-Urdu Benchmark
articles.abstract: Legal information assistants could help Urdu speakers understand their constitutional rights, but building reliable systems requires test data and evaluation methods suited to the language. We present LEGAL-UQA, a parallel English-Urdu benchmark of 619 question-answer pairs linked to passages from Pakistan's Constitution. Each example includes the question, reference answer, and source passage in both languages. We evaluate two components separately: answering Urdu questions when the source passage is supplied, and retrieving the passage from which each question was generated. We also compare JEV, a decision model used as an automated judge, with human grades. The findings show that model rankings depend on how answer similarity is measured, while a simple word-matching method retrieves source passages more effectively than the embedding methods tested. At the evaluated cutoff, JEV agrees with human grades less often than a baseline that gives every answer full credit. An audit also identifies cases where generated references omit information supported by the source. Together, these findings highlight the need to test retrieval and answering separately, include simple retrieval baselines, and validate automated judges and reference answers with human review when engineering legal QA software for Urdu speakers.
articles.titleCn: 为乌尔都语使用者测试宪法问答系统：基于英语-乌尔都语平行基准
articles.abstractCn: 法律信息助理可以帮助乌尔都语使用者理解他们的宪法权利，但构建可靠的系统需要适合该语言的测试数据和评估方法。我们提出了LEGAL-UQA，一个包含619个问答对的英语-乌尔都语平行基准，这些问答对与巴基斯坦宪法的段落相关联。每个示例都包含两种语言中的问题、参考答案和来源段落。我们分别评估了两个组件：在提供来源段落的情况下回答乌尔都语问题，以及从每个问题生成的段落中检索段落。我们还比较了JEV（一种用作自动裁判的决策模型）与人类评分。结果表明，模型排名取决于答案相似性的衡量方式，而简单的词匹配方法比测试的嵌入方法更有效地检索来源段落。在评估的截止点，JEV与人类评分的同意率低于给予每个答案全额分数的基线。审计还发现了生成参考答案遗漏了来源支持信息的情况。综合这些发现，强调了在为乌尔都语使用者开发法律问答软件时，需要分别测试检索和回答功能、包含简单的检索基线，并通过人工审核验证自动裁判和参考答案。

articles.title: Beyond Gold Standards: Epistemic Ensemble of LLM Judges for Formal Mathematical Reasoning
articles.abstract: Statement autoformalization plays a crucial role in formal mathematical reasoning by enabling the automatic translation of natural language statements into formal languages. While recent advances using large language models (LLMs) have shown promising capabilities in autoformalization, methods for automatically evaluating autoformalization remain underexplored. LLM-as-a-judge presents a promising approach for automating such evaluation, however, existing methods typically employ coarse-grained and generic evaluation criteria, which limit their effectiveness for advanced formal mathematical reasoning, where quality hinges on nuanced, multi-granular dimensions. In this work, we take a step toward addressing this gap by introducing a systematic, automatic method to evaluate autoformalization tasks. The proposed method is based on an epistemically and formally grounded ensemble (EFG) of LLM judges, defined on criteria encompassing logical preservation (LP), mathematical consistency (MC), formal quality (FQ), and formal validity (FV), resulting in a transparent assessment that accounts for different contributing factors. We validate the proposed framework to serve as a proxy for autoformalization assessment within the domain of formal mathematics. Overall, our experiments demonstrate that the EFG ensemble of LLM judges is a more suitable emerging proxy for evaluation than a coarse-grained model. These findings suggest that LLM judges, especially when guided by a well-defined set of atomic properties, could offer a scalable, interpretable, and reliable support for evaluating formal mathematical reasoning.
articles.titleCn: 超越黄金标准：用于形式数学推理的大型语言模型裁判的认知集成
articles.abstractCn: 声明自动形式化在形式化数学推理中发挥着关键作用，它能够将自然语言声明自动翻译成形式化语言。尽管近年来使用大型语言模型（LLM）在自动形式化方面取得了显著进展，但自动评估自动形式化的方法仍待探索。作为裁判的LLM（LLM-as-a-judge）为自动化此类评估提供了一种有前景的方法，然而现有方法通常采用粗粒度和通用的评估标准，这限制了它们在高级形式化数学推理中的有效性，因为在高级形式化数学推理中，质量取决于细致、多粒度的维度。在这项工作中，我们通过引入一种系统化、自动化的方法来评估自动形式化任务，朝着填补这一空白迈出了步伐。所提出的方法基于一个知识论和形式化基础的综合（EFG）LLM裁判，其定义的标准包括逻辑保留（LP）、数学一致性（MC）、形式质量（FQ）和形式有效性（FV），从而产生一个透明的评估，考虑了不同的贡献因素。我们验证了所提出的框架，使其在形式数学领域内充当自动形式化评估的代理。总的来说，我们的实验表明，EFG LLM裁判的综合体比粗粒度模型更适合作为评估的涌现代理。这些发现表明，LLM裁判，尤其是在良好定义的一组原子属性指导下，可以为评估形式化数学推理提供可扩展、可解释和可靠的支撑。

articles.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Multimodal Large Language Models with Incoherence-adjusted Semantic Volume
articles.abstract: Despite their capabilities, Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) may produce plausible but erroneous outputs, hindering reliable deployment. Accurate uncertainty metrics could enable escalation of unreliable queries to human experts or larger models for improved performance. However, existing uncertainty metrics have practical constraints, such as being designed only for specific modalities, reliant on external tools, or computationally expensive. We introduce UMPIRE, a training-free uncertainty quantification framework for MLLMs that works efficiently across various input and output modalities without external tools, relying only on the models' own internal modality features. Inspired by Determinantal Point Processes (DPPs), UMPIRE computes a novel incoherence-adjusted semantic volume of sampled MLLM responses for a given task instance, which couples semantic embedding dispersion with the quadratic entropy of the responses. This approach effectively captures both the global semantic diversity of samples and the local incoherence of responses based on internal model confidence. We provide theoretical analysis motivating UMPIRE's design, and extensive experiments show that UMPIRE consistently outperforms baseline metrics in error detection and uncertainty calibration across image, audio, and video-text benchmarks, even with small sample budgets. We also demonstrate UMPIRE's generalization to non-text output tasks, including image and audio generation. Our code is available at https://github.com/daohieu17ctt/UMPIRE.

articles.titleCn: 针对多模态大型语言模型的非一致性调整语义体积的不确定性量化
articles.abstractCn: 尽管具备强大功能，多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）仍可能产生看似合理但错误的输出，阻碍其可靠部署。精确的不确定性度量能够将不可靠的查询升级至人类专家或更大模型，从而提升性能。然而，现有的不确定性度量存在实际限制，例如仅针对特定模态设计、依赖外部工具或计算成本高昂。我们引入UMPIRE，这是一种无需训练的不确定性量化框架，适用于MLLMs，能够在各种输入和输出模态中高效运行，无需外部工具，仅依赖模型自身的内部模态特征。受确定性点过程（DPPs）启发，UMPIRE计算给定任务实例下采样MLLM响应的新型不一致性调整语义体积，该体积结合了语义嵌入分散度与响应的二次熵。这种方法有效捕捉了样本的全局语义多样性和基于内部模型置信度的响应局部不一致性。我们提供了支持UMPIRE设计的理论分析，并且广泛的实验表明，在图像、音频和视频-文本基准测试中，即使样本预算有限，UMPIRE在错误检测和不确定性校准方面始终优于基线度量。我们还展示了UMPIRE在非文本输出任务上的泛化能力，包括图像和音频生成。我们的代码可在https://github.com/daohieu17ctt/UMPIRE获取。

articles.title: Screen Before You Interpret: A Portable Validity Screen for Benchmark-Based LLM Confidence Signals
articles.abstract: LLM confidence signals drive abstention, routing and escalation, yet evaluations rarely check whether a signal varies with correctness before computing metrics on it. Clinical personality assessment handles the analogous problem by screening response validity before interpreting substantive scales. We specify a portable screen in that tradition. From the correctness-by-confidence table it computes the rate of high confidence on errors (L), the rate of low confidence on correct answers (Fp), and their contrast (RBS, equal to minus Youden's J). It adds no new statistics: it separates blanket confidence, blanket withdrawal and inversion, attaches interval guards, and calls a signal Valid only when it measurably tracks correctness. On 20 frontier models answering 452 two-alternative items with binary KEEP/WITHDRAW probes, one model is Invalid (DeepSeek-R1 withdraws 95% of its correct answers), four are Indeterminate and 15 are Valid. Two Indeterminate models keep confidence on 96% of their errors but make too few errors to certify it; certification needs 35 to 139 errors. Only 6 of the 20 verdicts reproduce reliably on half the items. On verbalized 0-100 confidence (33 models on 1,500 MMLU items, 20 on a second 500-item sample, and Yang et al.'s data for 11 models on 10 benchmarks), the verdict depends on the cut point: at 50 most models are Invalid because answers pile at the ceiling, while at 90-95 most pass. Battery item sensitivity does not predict MMLU discrimination (rho = -.07). Protocol amendments were settled on these data, so the verdicts are descriptive pending a held-out test. This version corrects scoring, grading, classification and reporting errors in version 1 and supersedes arXiv:2604.17707 and 2604.17716.

articles.titleCn: 屏幕前的解读：基于基准的LLM置信信号的有效性便携式检测工具
articles.abstractCn: LLM置信度信号驱动着回避、路由和升级，但评估很少在计算指标前检查信号是否随正确性变化。临床人格评估通过在解释实质性量表前筛选反应有效性来处理类似问题。我们在此传统中指定了一种便携式筛选方法。从正确性-置信度表中，它计算出高置信度错误率（L）、低置信度正确率（Fp）及其对比度（RBS，等于-Youden's J）。它不引入新的统计量：它分离了全面置信度、全面回避和反转，附加了区间保护，并且只有当信号可测量地跟踪正确性时才称其为有效。在20个前沿模型回答452个二选一项目，使用二进制KEEP/WITHDRAW探针时，其中一个模型无效（DeepSeek-R1回避了95%的正确答案），四个模型不确定，15个模型有效。两个不确定模型在96%的错误上保持置信度，但错误太少无法认证；认证需要35到139个错误。只有20个评估中的6个在半数项目上可靠地重现。在口头表达的0-100置信度（33个模型在1500个MMLU项目，20个在第二个500个项目样本，以及Yang等人11个模型在10个基准上的数据）中，评估结果取决于切割点：在50时大多数模型无效因为答案堆积在上限，而在90-95时大多数通过。电池项目敏感性不能预测MMLU区分度（rho = -.07）。根据这些数据确定了协议修正，因此评估结果为描述性，等待保留测试。此版本修正了版本1中的评分、分级、分类和报告错误，并取代了arXiv:2604.17707和2604.17716。

articles.title: SA-RAG: Structuring Noisy Conversations for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in conversational applications. However, their reliance on parametric knowledge limits reliability in real-world scenarios that require dynamic or domain-specific information. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by incorporating external knowledge during generation, but existing RAG methods often struggle with noisy or irrelevant contexts, as they typically assume that high-quality structures are already available. In this work, we propose Structure-aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation (SA-RAG), a principled structure induction and generation framework that constructs reliable intermediate structures directly from noisy conversational data. SA-RAG uses tables as compact and controllable structured representations. We introduce a quality-aware structure induction framework that jointly models semantic and structural consistency. Furthermore, we explore both training-free and training-based structure generation strategies to further improve structure quality while maintaining fidelity. Experiments on two noisy real-world datasets show that SA-RAG significantly outperforms existing RAG baselines. Further analysis highlights that high-quality structural representations are crucial for robust RAG applications.
articles.titleCn: SA-RAG：用于检索增强生成的含噪声对话结构化方法
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）已广泛应用于对话应用中。然而，它们对参数化知识的依赖限制了在需要动态或领域特定信息的现实场景中的可靠性。检索增强生成（RAG）通过在生成过程中整合外部知识来解决这一局限性，但现有的RAG方法通常难以处理噪声或不相关的上下文，因为它们通常假设高质量的架构已经可用。在这项工作中，我们提出了结构感知检索增强生成（SA-RAG），这是一个基于原则的结构归纳和生成框架，它直接从噪声对话数据中构建可靠的中间结构。SA-RAG使用表格作为紧凑且可控的结构化表示。我们引入了一个质量感知结构归纳框架，该框架联合建模语义和结构一致性。此外，我们探索了无训练和基于训练的结构生成策略，以在保持保真度的同时进一步提高结构质量。在两个噪声真实世界数据集上的实验表明，SA-RAG显著优于现有的RAG基线。进一步分析强调，高质量的结构化表示对于鲁棒的RAG应用至关重要。

articles.title: From Facts to Insights: A Persona-Driven Dual Memory Framework and Dataset for Role-Playing Agents
articles.abstract: While role-playing agents excel in short-term interactions, long-term conversations overwhelm context windows, motivating external memory frameworks. Current systems typically rely on persona-agnostic summarization, which records facts without persona-specific interpretation, yielding generic responses that compromise persona fidelity. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoleMemo, a dataset featuring four reasoning tasks where the factual fragments must be interpreted through the persona to reach the correct answer. Evaluation on RoleMemo exposes critical limitations of persona-agnostic frameworks. We thus propose DualMem, which decouples memory into two streams: factual cognition and persona-conditioned insight. Trained through Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), our framework with a 4B-parameter model outperforms zero-shot persona-agnostic frameworks powered by DeepSeek-V3.2 for sustained persona fidelity. Our resources are available at https://github.com/Collab-Gen/RoleMemo.
articles.titleCn: 从事实到洞见：一个以角色为导向的双重记忆框架和数据集，用于角色扮演代理
articles.abstractCn: 虽然角色扮演代理在短期交互中表现出色，但长期对话会使上下文窗口不堪重负，从而推动外部记忆框架的发展。当前系统通常依赖与角色无关的摘要，这种摘要记录事实但不进行角色特定的解读，导致生成通用响应，从而损害了角色的忠实度。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了RoleMemo，这是一个包含四个推理任务的数据库，其中事实片段必须通过角色解读才能得出正确答案。在RoleMemo上的评估揭示了与角色无关框架的关键局限性。因此，我们提出了DualMem，该框架将记忆解耦为两个流：事实认知和角色条件洞察。通过监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）进行训练，我们具有4B参数的框架在持续角色忠实度方面优于由DeepSeek-V3.2驱动的零样本与角色无关框架。我们的资源可在https://github.com/Collab-Gen/RoleMemo获取。

articles.title: When Simpler Is Better: Evaluating Translation Pipelines for Medieval Latin Manuscripts
articles.abstract: Despite remarkable progress in machine translation, Vision Language Models (VLMs) struggle on historical manuscripts, a domain that stresses core Natural Language Processing (NLP) capabilities: low-resource transliteration, archaic vocabulary, and noisy input signals. We present a systematic framework for evaluating the full image-to-translation pipeline on medieval Latin manuscripts, a setting in which scribal shorthand, ligatures, and parchment degradation expose failure modes that are invisible in clean-text benchmarks. Benchmarking on the CATMuS Latin dataset reveals a specialization gap: domain-specific Optical Character Recognition (OCR) models reduce character error rate by up to 4.3$\times$ compared to general-purpose VLMs, despite operating at orders of magnitude fewer parameters. We introduce the Interpres-Parallel-Corpus (IPC), a novel dataset comprising 1,383 aligned manuscript image lines, transcriptions, and expert translations, to our knowledge the first of its kind for medieval Latin. Our experiments uncover a complexity paradox: the simplest pipeline, a specialized OCR model feeding directly into a VLM, outperforms all multi-component variants. Adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) or post-OCR correction introduces prompt saturation and error propagation that degrade aggregate translation quality. These findings offer both a new benchmark and practical guidance for deploying translation systems in low-resource historical settings.
articles.titleCn: 当简单更好时：评估用于中世纪拉丁手稿的翻译流程
articles.abstractCn: 尽管机器翻译取得了显著进展，但视觉语言模型（VLMs）在历史手稿上的表现仍然不佳，这一领域考验着核心的自然语言处理（NLP）能力：低资源转写、古语词汇以及输入信号的噪声。我们提出了一种系统框架，用于评估中世纪拉丁手稿上的完整图像到翻译流程，在这种环境下，抄写员的速记符号、连写以及羊皮纸的降解暴露了在干净文本基准测试中无法显现的失效模式。在CATMuS拉丁数据集上的基准测试揭示了专业化的差距：与通用VLMs相比，特定领域的光学字符识别（OCR）模型将字符错误率降低了高达4.3倍，尽管其参数数量少了一个数量级。我们引入了Interpres-Parallel-Corpus（IPC），这是一个包含1,383条对齐的手稿图像行、转录文本和专家翻译的新型数据集，据我们所知，这是首个针对中世纪拉丁语的数据集。我们的实验揭示了一个复杂性悖论：最简单的流程——一个专门的OCR模型直接输入到VLM中——优于所有多组件变体。添加检索增强生成（RAG）或OCR后校正会导致提示饱和和错误传播，从而降低整体翻译质量。这些发现既提供了一种新的基准，也为在低资源历史环境中部署翻译系统提供了实用指导。

articles.title: BBOWP-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Black-Box Optimization Word Problems
articles.abstract: Formulating an optimization problem strongly affects final solution quality, yet good formulations usually require substantial expertise. Recent studies have explored automatically deriving optimization problems from natural-language descriptions, but existing benchmarks focus on settings where objectives and constraints can be written explicitly as mathematical expressions. Many practically important problems are naturally treated as black-box optimization (BBO) problems, in which only objective values are observable, and the functional form is unavailable. In BBO, search space design (as part of problem formulation) and optimization algorithm selection are crucial for problem-solving. Automating these processes with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging. We introduce Black-Box Optimization Word Problems (BBOWP), a novel problem setting in which a system must infer both a search space and an optimization algorithm from a natural-language description of a black-box optimization task. To support research on this setting, we establish the BBOWP Benchmark Suite (BBOWP-Bench), a dataset and evaluation framework for BBOWP. Each instance combines a natural-language problem description, an executable evaluation environment, and a human-designed reference formulation, allowing evaluation of both search-space design and algorithm selection. Using this benchmark, we evaluate LLMs on the joint formulation of search spaces and optimizers from natural-language descriptions across multiple BBO domains. We show that current LLMs vary their optimizer choice with the evaluation budget, though they sometimes struggle with search space design, particularly in identifying important variables and balancing their ranges when the problem description is less informative or the search space is highly problem-specific. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/shiralab/bbowp-bench.
articles.titleCn: BBOWP-Bench：在黑盒优化应用题上评估大型语言模型
articles.abstractCn: 构建优化问题对最终解的质量有显著影响，但良好的构建通常需要大量专业知识。近期研究探索了从自然语言描述中自动推导优化问题，但现有的基准主要关注目标函数和约束条件可以显式地写成数学表达式的情况。许多实际重要的问题自然地被视为黑盒优化（BBO）问题，其中仅可观测目标值，而函数形式未知。在BBO中，搜索空间设计（作为问题构建的一部分）和优化算法选择对于问题解决至关重要。利用大型语言模型（LLM）自动化这些过程仍然具有挑战性。我们引入了黑盒优化词问题（BBOWP），这是一个新颖的问题设置，其中系统必须从黑盒优化任务的自然语言描述中推断出搜索空间和优化算法。为了支持该设置的研究，我们建立了BBOWP基准套件（BBOWP-Bench），这是一个用于BBOWP的数据集和评估框架。每个实例结合了自然语言问题描述、可执行的评估环境和人工设计的参考构建，允许评估搜索空间设计和算法选择。利用该基准，我们评估了LLM在多个BBO领域从自然语言描述中联合构建搜索空间和优化器的表现。我们发现当前LLM会根据评估预算变化其优化器选择，尽管它们有时在搜索空间设计方面存在困难，特别是在问题描述信息较少或搜索空间高度特定于问题时，难以识别重要变量并平衡其范围。我们的代码和数据集可在https://github.com/shiralab/bbowp-bench获取。

articles.title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
articles.abstract: Large language models struggle to reliably identify and correct errors in their own reasoning. Unlike prior training-based approaches that fine-tune an LLM to generate revisions or feedback, we learn where to intervene in failed rollouts and determine how to redirect them. To choose where to intervene, we train a 130K-parameter MLP head on a frozen encoder using only final-answer correctness. For redirection, we find that under a fixed generation budget, the tested inline injections fail to reliably redirect reasoning, whereas presenting the same instruction in a new user turn changes the model's course. The resulting correction framework, UPTURN (User-Prompt TURN injection at a learned position), requires no LLM fine-tuning: it retains a selected prefix, injects an instruction as a new user turn, and regenerates the suffix. Across four reasoners and six math benchmarks, UPTURN improves average accuracy in every setting over a 32-rollout baseline. It outperforms self-correction and reflection-token injection baselines under matched correction budgets, transfers across reasoners and to GPQA-Diamond without retraining, and complements GRPO and self-correction methods.
articles.titleCn: 注入转折，而非标记：学习如何将LLM推理重定向以实现自我纠正
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型难以可靠地识别并纠正自身推理中的错误。与以往基于微调语言模型生成修订或反馈的方法不同，我们学习在失败的推理过程中进行干预，并确定如何引导其走向正确方向。为了选择干预的位置，我们在冻结的编码器上训练了一个130K参数的多层感知机头部，仅使用最终答案的正确性作为训练目标。对于引导过程，我们发现，在固定的生成预算下，测试中的行内注入无法可靠地引导推理，而将相同的指令以新的用户回合呈现则改变了模型的走向。由此产生的修正框架UPTURN（在学习的位置进行用户提示的TURN注入），无需对语言模型进行微调：它保留选定的前缀，将指令注入为新的用户回合，并重新生成后缀。在四个推理器和六个数学基准测试中，UPTURN在所有设置下均比32次推理的基线提高了平均准确率。在匹配的修正预算下，UPTURN优于自我修正和反射标记注入的基线，能够在推理器之间和迁移到GPQA-Diamond而无需重新训练，并补充了GRPO和自我修正方法。

articles.title: Similar Models, Broken Odds: Where Luce's Axiom Fails in Chatbot Arena
articles.abstract: Chatbot Arena gives each language model one Bradley-Terry score, which fixes how often any model should beat any other. Choice theory predicts where this fails: near-copies are compared on the few details in which they differ, so votes between them are more decisive than their scores imply, exactly for the comparison a lab cares about, a new version against the old one. On 1.8 million Arena votes, votes between versions of one model are 1.37 times as decisive as Bradley-Terry predicts, between sizes of one generation 1.26 times and between models of one lab 1.12 times; a release a year later points the same way, and the effect survives tie, prompt, topic and timing checks. How alike two models' answers are worded and formatted tracks the effect. Plain scores leave the odds between relatives about 9% too close to even on held-out votes; a correction with four to six parameters roughly halves this and predicts held-out votes better, mostly by modeling ties, while the leaderboard order barely moves; frozen and carried to new releases, its gains in head-to-head odds are too small for our test to establish. With language-model judges and three-answer menus, a near-copy takes votes mostly from its twin when choices are pooled over prompts (log-odds shift +0.10, 95% interval 0.05 to 0.16), less so within a prompt.
articles.comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, 10 tables; v3: adds a test on human summarization preferences and a calculation of votes needed for a release decision; clearer abstract, introduction and transfer results; appendix regrouped
articles.titleCn: 相似模型，失衡概率：卢斯公理在Chatbot Arena中的失效
articles.abstractCn: Chatbot Arena 为每个语言模型分配一个 Bradley-Terry 分数，该分数固定了任何模型应击败其他模型的频率。选择理论预测了这种方法在哪些情况下会失效：当近似的模型被比较时，它们只在少数不同的细节上进行比较，因此它们之间的投票比分数所暗示的更为决定性，这正是实验室关心的比较——新版本与旧版本之间的比较。在 180 万次 Arena 投票中，同一模型不同版本之间的投票比 Bradley-Terry 预测的 1.37 倍更具决定性，同一代不同规模之间的投票比 1.26 倍，同一实验室不同模型之间的投票比 1.12 倍；一年后的发布也指向同样的方向，这种效应在平局、提示、主题和时间检查中依然存在。两个模型回答措辞和格式的相似程度追踪了这种效应。原始分数使得亲属之间的概率在保留投票中过于接近于均等，约高 9%；使用四个到六个参数的修正模型将这种偏差减少了一半，并更好地预测保留投票，主要通过模拟平局，而排行榜顺序几乎未变；冻结并应用于新发布中，其在新旧版本一对一概率上的增益太小，无法通过我们的测试来确立。使用语言模型裁判和三选项菜单，当跨提示合并选择时，近似模型主要从其双胞胎那里获得投票（对数概率变化 +0.10，95% 区间为 0.05 至 0.16），而在单个提示内则相对较少。

articles.title: Pluralistic Alignment in Large Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
articles.abstract: Pluralistic alignment aims to represent meaningful variation in human preferences rather than collapse heterogeneous judgments into a single target. Yet existing work often mixes three distinct questions: what pluralistic behavior a model should exhibit, whose preferences define the reference, and what evidence is sufficient to demonstrate success. We organize the literature around a two-layer taxonomy. Layer 1 distinguishes representing a range of human-supported viewpoints (Overton Pluralism), adapting faithfully to a specified perspective or preference condition (Steerable Pluralism), and matching the response distribution observed in a target population (Distributional Pluralism). Layer 2 distinguishes aggregate populations, countries and regions, and subgroups as human references. Preference representation, implementation mechanism, modality, and evidence quality are treated as cross-cutting design choices rather than additional forms of pluralism. We synthesize a protocol-bounded corpus of 70 works on pluralistic alignment and neighboring areas, using the objective-by-human-reference matrix to map existing approaches and identify underexplored combinations. The coded literature concentrates on Steerable Pluralism and Distributional Pluralism, while eligible Overton Pluralism work appears only at the aggregate-population level under our stated protocol. We then connect each objective to the evidence needed to support it, including perspective validity, conditional fidelity, distributional fidelity, support preservation, and uncertainty in subgroup estimates. Together, the taxonomy and evaluation framework clarify what current methods establish, where their claims exceed their evidence, and how future systems can represent disagreement without mistaking variation for faithful representation.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型的多元对齐：目标、人类参考和偏好表示
articles.abstractCn: 多元对齐旨在体现人类偏好的有意义差异，而非将异质判断归并为单一目标。然而现有工作常将三个不同问题混淆：模型应展现何种多元行为、谁的偏好定义参照标准，以及何种证据足以证明成功。我们围绕双层分类法组织文献。第一层区分体现人类支持的多重视角（奥尔顿多元主义）、忠实适应指定视角或偏好条件（可操控多元主义），以及匹配目标群体中观察到的响应分布（分布多元主义）。第二层区分总体人群、国家和地区以及亚群体作为人类参照。偏好表示、实现机制、模态和证据质量被视为跨领域设计选择，而非多元主义的额外形式。我们综合了70篇关于多元对齐及其邻近领域的协议约束语料，利用目标-人类参照矩阵映射现有方法并识别未充分探索的组合。编码文献集中于可操控多元主义和分布多元主义，而符合规定的奥尔顿多元主义工作仅在我们提出的协议下出现在总体人群层面。随后我们将每个目标与支持其所需的证据相连接，包括视角有效性、条件忠实度、分布忠实度、支持保留和亚群体估计中的不确定性。综合而言，分类法和评估框架阐明了当前方法确立了什么、其主张如何超出证据范围，以及未来系统如何在不将差异误认为忠实表示的情况下体现分歧。

articles.title: Integrate the Reward, Don't Sample It: Window Likelihood for Interruptions and Backchannels in Full-Duplex Speech Models
articles.abstract: When a user talks over a full-duplex dialogue model, it must decide whether the user is interrupting (stop) or backchannelling (carry on). Post-training can improve this discrimination or change how readily it stops. In our GRPO runs the second dominates: no configuration lowers both error rates on more than one model, and two released checkpoints discriminate no better than their bases. We trace this partly to how the reward is estimated. The probability of stopping inside a short window is a known function of a few stop probabilities the policy emits, yet GRPO estimates it by sampling. A group of rollouts that all agree gives no gradient, even when all fail; the push on the stop threshold is strongest where the model is unsure, whichever outcome is right; and whole-rollout credit reaches decisions the reward never judges. Confining the credit to the window removes only that leakage. Window likelihood (WL) samples the words but integrates over the stop decisions, so the probability of the correct outcome is computed exactly and its logarithm maximised. On HumDial-FDBench, across four open models, WL gives the best F1 and lowers both error rates by more than their confidence intervals, without talking into silence.
articles.titleCn: 整合奖励，而非采样：全双工语音模型中干扰和反馈的窗口似然
articles.abstractCn: 当用户与全双工对话模型进行交互时，模型必须判断用户是在中断（停止）还是在进行回传（继续）。训练后优化可以改进这种区分能力或改变模型停止的倾向性。在我们的GRPO运行中，第二种情况占主导地位：没有配置能同时降低超过一个模型的错误率，而发布的两个检查点与它们的基准模型相比并无更好区分能力。我们将此部分归因于奖励估计的方式。在短窗口内停止的概率是政策发出的几个停止概率的已知函数，但GRPO通过采样来估计它。一组所有结果都一致的运行不会产生梯度，即使所有运行都失败；对停止阈值的推动在模型不确定的情况下最为强烈，无论哪种结果是正确的；整个运行的信用会影响到奖励从未评判的决策。将信用限制在窗口内只能消除这种泄漏。窗口似然（WL）采样单词但整合停止决策，因此正确结果的概率被精确计算，并最大化其对数。在HumDial-FDBench上，针对四个开放模型，WL给出了最佳的F1值，并将两种错误率都降低了超过它们的置信区间，而不会导致模型沉默。

articles.title: Who Pays for the Knowledge Models Copy? Model Collapse as Lossy Transmission and Rogers' Paradox
articles.abstract: Generative models trained on the output of earlier models lose knowledge across generations, rare knowledge first. The remedies that work all bring in information from outside the loop, such as fresh human data, verifiers, or curators, and the theory of model collapse treats that supply as given. We argue that cultural evolution has a theory of the supply, and that it distinguishes two ways copying loses knowledge. In a fixed world, copies are lossy, as in Henrich's account of skill loss in small populations. In a changing world, even perfect copies go stale, which is Rogers' paradox. We write both as one chain with separately measurable parameters and test it on lineages of language models (word trigrams and a character transformer on two books, and OPT-125m on wikitext-2, on arXiv abstracts written after its pretraining, and on a world of 2,000 fictional facts that change at a set rate). In a fixed world, neutral drift on word frequencies predicts, with no free parameter, the rare-word coverage of every trigram lineage to within 0.03. In the fact world, the model's accuracy falls and its outdated answers rise with the rate of change; the chain calibrated on the static world predicts both for mid- and low-frequency facts to within 0.03 on average, with the rate of change set, not fitted. Models that inherit their weights keep more in a static world and carry more outdated facts in a changing one, as Rogers' theory says of individual memory. Finally we close the loop with the people who write the data. When they can ask the model instead of finding out, the model ends up exactly as reliable as finding out is costly, and in both regimes someone must keep paying to learn; we give the share in closed form, extend it to lossy copying, heterogeneous costs, aggregating models, and users who check, and show when checking is a stable way out.
articles.titleCn: 谁为知识模型的副本付费？模型坍塌作为有损传输和罗杰斯悖论
articles.abstractCn: 在早期模型输出的基础上训练的生成模型会随着世代传递而逐渐丧失知识，首先是稀有知识。所有有效的补救措施都引入了循环外部的信息，例如新鲜的人类数据、验证者或策展人，而模型崩溃理论将这种供应视为既定。我们认为文化进化具有关于供应的理论，并区分了复制丧失知识的两种方式。在一个固定世界中，复制是有损的，正如亨里奇在小种群技能丧失理论中的描述。在一个变化世界中，即使完美的复制也会过时，这是罗杰斯悖论。我们将两者视为一个具有可分别测量的参数的链条，并在语言模型的谱系上进行了测试（包括单词三元组和两本书上的字符转换器，以及OPT-125m在wikitext-2、在其预训练后撰写的arXiv摘要，以及一个以固定速率变化的2000个虚构事实的世界）。在一个固定世界中，词频的中性漂移预测，无需自由参数，每个三元组谱系的稀有词覆盖率在0.03以内。在事实世界中，模型的准确率随着变化速率的升高而下降，过时答案的比例上升；基于静态世界校准的链条平均在0.03以内预测中低频事实，变化速率是设定的，而非拟合的。继承权重的模型在静态世界中保留更多信息，在变化世界中携带更多过时事实，正如罗杰斯对个体记忆的理论所述。最后，我们通过数据撰写者关闭了循环。当人们可以通过询问模型而不是自行查找时，模型的可靠性最终与查找的成本相匹配，在两种体制下都必须有人持续支付以获取知识；我们以封闭形式给出了份额，将其扩展到有损复制、异构成本、聚合模型以及进行检查的用户，并展示了何时检查是一种稳定的方式。

articles.title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
articles.abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety mechanisms and elicit harmful or unintended outputs. Although safety can be improved through model fine-tuning, such approaches can be computationally expensive and may degrade previously acquired capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. Recent jailbreak defenses have therefore explored targeted interventions on specific model components associated with unsafe behavior. However, existing approaches typically decouple two inherently related decisions: where to intervene and how to modify the selected components. Such sequential optimization may be suboptimal because the optimal intervention location can depend on the intervention applied there, and vice versa. In this work, we introduce AttentionSwitch, the first jailbreak defense to jointly optimize intervention sites and strengths within a frozen LLM. Specifically, AttentionSwitch learns a sparse set of attention heads together with query-conditioned multiplicative scaling factors, allowing the outputs of the selected heads to be either attenuated or amplified without altering the directions of their representations. Across popular language models and jailbreak attacks, AttentionSwitch outperforms existing defenses, with particularly strong results when training data is scarce.
articles.titleCn: 注意力切换：通过稀疏注意力头选择和缩放的联合学习为LLM提供越狱防御
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型在广泛任务中取得了卓越性能，但它们仍然容易受到绕过安全机制并产生有害或不期望输出的越狱攻击。尽管可以通过模型微调来提高安全性，但这类方法可能计算成本高昂，并且可能通过灾难性遗忘降低先前获得的性能。因此，最近的越狱防御探索了针对与不安全行为相关特定模型组件的定向干预。然而，现有方法通常将两个本质上相关的决策解耦：在哪里干预以及如何修改选定的组件。这种顺序优化可能次优，因为最佳干预位置可能取决于在该位置应用的干预，反之亦然。在这项工作中，我们引入了AttentionSwitch，这是首个在冻结的大型语言模型内联合优化干预位置和强度的越狱防御。具体而言，AttentionSwitch学习一组稀疏的注意力头以及查询条件下的乘法缩放因子，允许选定的头的输出被衰减或放大，而不会改变其表示的方向。在流行的语言模型和越狱攻击中，AttentionSwitch优于现有防御，在训练数据稀缺时尤其表现出色。

articles.title: How Much Is Left Matters: False Positives and False Negatives in Partial-Prompt Contamination Tests
articles.abstract: Partial-prompt completion, where a model receives the first part of a benchmark problem and is checked for whether it reproduces the rest, is a widely used test for benchmark contamination. We audit this test on seven open-weight models using MATH-500 and recent AIME 2025/2026 problems, which serve as true negatives. Memorization flags depend strongly on how much text remains: for every model, problems with at most 8 leftover words are flagged several times more often than problems with at least 25 (31.5% vs. 5.5% for Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct), and half to three-quarters of all ROUGE-based flags come from short leftovers. On true negatives, a ROUGE-L >= 0.75 threshold flags up to 6.7% of problems at a 60% prefix, and at an 80% prefix even exact match flags 8.6% (pooled over models; 6.2% on AIME 2026, which postdates every model), against 0% at 40-60%. The test also misses contamination upstream: models distilled from Qwen2.5-Math, whose base is heavily flagged in prior work, show almost no model-specific recall. Calibrating each model against models from other families removes most flags while isolating a consistent Qwen2.5-specific signal at every prefix length. We recommend length-stratified reporting, prefixes of at most 60%, style-matched post-cutoff controls, and cross-family calibration.

articles.titleCn: 剩余多少很重要：部分提示污染测试中的假阳性与假阴性
articles.abstractCn: 部分提示完成，即模型接收基准问题的前一部分并检查其是否能够复现剩余部分，是广泛用于测试基准数据污染的一种方法。我们使用MATH-500和近期AIME 2025/2026问题（作为真正的阴性对照）对七种开源权重模型进行了这项测试。记忆标志强烈依赖于剩余文本的长度：对于每个模型，剩余最多8个词的问题被标记的频率是剩余至少25个词的问题的数倍（对于Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct，分别为31.5%和5.5%），并且基于ROUGE的标志中有一半到四分之三来自短余量。在真正的阴性对照中，ROUGE-L >= 0.75的阈值在60%前缀下会标记高达6.7%的问题，而在80%前缀下，即使完全匹配也会标记8.6%（跨模型汇总；AIME 2026上为6.2%，该问题发布时间晚于所有模型）。该测试还会遗漏上游的污染：从Qwen2.5-Math蒸馏出的模型（其基础在先前工作中被大量标记）几乎不显示模型特定的召回率。通过与其他家族的模型进行校准，可以消除大多数标志，同时在每个前缀长度上分离出一致的Qwen2.5特定信号。我们建议采用长度分层报告、最多60%的前缀、风格匹配的后截断控制和跨家族校准。

articles.title: onóna: Twin Embeddings with Tied Unembeddings
articles.abstract: Weight tying reduces the parameter cost of language models, but the usual tied output head is limited to a single softmax. We introduce onóna, a two-table parameterization that increases output expressiveness while preserving input-output weight sharing. The Transformer takes the average of two embedding tables as input, and the output head combines the softmax distributions defined by those same tables. A gate conditioned only on the current input token determines the mixture weight. Its values can be precomputed for inference, and the Transformer body remains unchanged. We evaluate onóna across Dense, Gated DeltaNet hybrid, mixture-of-experts, and Attention Residual architectures at 142M, 330M, and 1B scales. Under matched token budgets, onóna lowers final validation loss and external perplexity in 11 of 12 comparisons and raises the average accuracy over eight downstream tasks in 10 of 12. The one exception on loss is the 1B MoE model. The cost is one extra embedding table and one extra vocabulary projection.
articles.titleCn: onóna：绑定未嵌入的双嵌入
articles.abstractCn: 权重绑定减少了语言模型的参数成本，但通常绑定的输出头仅限于单个softmax。我们引入了onóna，一种双表参数化方法，在保持输入输出权重共享的同时提高了输出表达能力。Transformer将两个嵌入表的平均值作为输入，输出头结合由这些相同表定义的softmax分布。一个仅基于当前输入标记的门控决定了混合权重。其值可以预先计算用于推理，Transformer主体保持不变。我们在142M、330M和1B规模的Dense、Gated DeltaNet混合、专家混合和Attention Residual架构上评估了onóna。在匹配的标记预算下，onóna在12次比较中的11次降低了最终验证损失和外部困惑度，并在12次中的10次提高了八个下游任务的平均准确率。唯一例外是1B MoE模型的损失。成本是一个额外的嵌入表和一个额外的词汇投影。

articles.title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories is a standard paradigm for training LLM agents. However, it suffers from a well-known training-inference distribution mismatch, calling for target-aware data synthesis strategies that ground the training data in the target model's native state distribution. To bridge this gap, emerging approaches incorporate the expert either to guide mixed rollouts alongside the target model, or to provide dense step-wise supervision. Nonetheless, existing methods apply expert assistance blind to the target model's inherent behavior: they either disrupt the rollout using sub-optimal random intervention heuristics, or they enforce indiscriminate uniform supervision that unnecessarily overwrites the model's already-correct actions. We introduce JudgeMix, a judge-guided data synthesis framework that dynamically interleaves the target model and expert based on step-wise semantic evaluations. JudgeMix queries expert guidance precisely when the target model struggles, ensuring high trajectory success rates while keeping the state distribution aligned with the target model. It additionally uses the judge evaluation to reweight expert supervision on different steps, preserving model's inherent valid behavior while correcting its errors. On two agentic tool-use benchmarks, AppWorld and AutomationBench, JudgeMix demonstrates consistent superior performance to existing methods, with improvements up to 10 pass@1 points.
articles.titleCn: JudgeMix：用于LLM智能体的判别引导混合输出数据合成
articles.abstractCn: 在专家轨迹上的监督微调（SFT）是训练大型语言模型（LLM）代理的标准范式。然而，它存在一个众所周知的训练-推理分布不匹配问题，需要采用目标感知的数据合成策略，使训练数据基于目标模型的原始状态分布。为了弥合这一差距，新兴方法将专家纳入其中，以引导与目标模型混合的推进，或提供密集的逐步监督。然而，现有方法对目标模型的固有行为盲目应用专家协助：它们要么使用次优随机干预启发式方法破坏推进，要么强制执行无差别的均匀监督，不必要地覆盖模型已经正确的动作。我们介绍了JudgeMix，这是一个基于裁判指导的数据合成框架，根据逐步语义评估动态地交错目标模型和专家。JudgeMix在目标模型遇到困难时精确地查询专家指导，确保高轨迹成功率，同时保持状态分布与目标模型一致。它还使用裁判评估对不同步骤上的专家监督进行重新加权，在纠正模型错误的同时保留其固有的有效行为。在两个代理工具使用基准测试AppWorld和AutomationBench上，JudgeMix始终优于现有方法，性能提升高达10个pass@1点。

articles.title: Indic-Task Gains and Regressions after Reinforcement Learning
articles.abstract: We run reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO across four environments, starting from a supervised fine-tuned 30B-A3B mixture-of-experts model covering English and eight Indic languages. We compare the model before and after RL across 34 benchmarks in one evaluation campaign. MATH improves by 36.07 points, and most Indic benchmarks also improve. Yet XQuAD-Indic F1 falls 19.32 points as English answers rise from 8.7% to 91.7%; IndicQA falls 8.64, while English XQuAD gains 11.71 F1. A second RL run from the same supervised initialization adds an Indic environment together with language and repetition rewards. Compared with the released model, it improves both passage-answering and instruction-following benchmarks, along with preserving MATH performance. But it loses ground on reasoning and coding benchmarks. Several training choices changed together, so we cannot isolate the effect of any one of the reward terms. Script compliance remains unresolved. Adding a language reward did not ensure use of the requested script. Passage answering and script compliance therefore need direct evaluation, even when other benchmark scores improve.
articles.comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
articles.titleCn: 强化学习后的印地语任务增益与退化
articles.abstractCn: 我们在四个环境中运行了带有GRPO的强化学习（RL），起始模型为涵盖英语和八种印度语的30B-A3B专家混合模型，该模型经过监督微调。在一个评估活动中，我们在34个基准测试中比较了RL前后模型的性能。MATH得分提高了36.07分，大多数印度语基准测试也取得了提升。然而，随着英语答案比例从8.7%上升到91.7%，XQuAD-Indic F1得分下降了19.32分；IndicQA得分下降了8.64分，而英语XQuAD F1得分提高了11.71分。第二次从相同的监督初始化进行RL运行，同时增加了印度语环境以及语言和重复奖励。与发布的模型相比，它在段落回答和指令遵循基准测试中均有提升，并保持了MATH性能。但它却在推理和编码基准测试中表现下降。由于同时更改了多个训练选择，我们无法分离出任何一个奖励项的影响。脚本合规性问题仍未解决。增加语言奖励并不能确保使用请求的脚本。因此，即使其他基准测试得分提高，段落回答和脚本合规性仍需直接评估。

articles.title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
articles.abstract: Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. Response-level metrics saturate on this failure, and a rule that reads only the response length scores almost perfectly, while probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under PREWARN. Probes warn before the onset on most degenerate responses of two of the three models, low-rank adapters below the probe more than double the share of tokens just before the onset that it flags, largely by flagging degenerate responses long before the onset, and no untrained baseline warns much more often than random alarms. We release the probes with calibrated thresholds at https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes
articles.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpretability as a Science. 30 pages (10 main text), 6 figures, 16 tables. Code: https://github.com/swiss-ai/degeneration-probe
articles.titleCn: 检测并非预警：评估语言模型失效的词级警报
articles.abstractCn: 许多语言模型的失败往往始于一个特定的标记，即起始点。在生成过程中读取模型的监控器可以对最终响应进行分类，一旦失败开始即可检测，或在开始前发出警告，而只有警告才能留出时间停止或引导生成。监控器通常使用响应级指标（如AUROC）进行评估，这些指标忽略了监控器触发的时间。我们引入了PREWARN，这是一个用于任何具有标注起始点的失败的评估协议。它将每个监控器的阈值在验证数据上校准到应用中选择的错误率，运行监控器，并相对于起始点在所有三个任务中对监控器的警报进行评分。作为一个案例研究，我们将其应用于三个开源语言模型中的重复退化，以早期警告为主要任务，使用激活上的线性探针和六个未训练的基线。响应级指标在这个失败上达到饱和，而只读取响应长度的规则几乎完美地评分，而AUROC排名相同的探针在PREWARN下发出截然不同的警告。在三个模型中的两个模型的多数退化响应上，探针在起始点之前发出警告，低秩适配器在探针之下标记的起始点之前的标记份额超过了两倍，这主要是通过在起始点之前标记退化响应来实现的，并且没有未训练的基线比随机警报更频繁地发出警告。我们在https://huggingface.co/collections/marcodene/prewarn-degeneration-probes上发布了校准阈值的探针。

articles.title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
articles.abstract: Evaluations of multi-agent language models often compare communicating architectures against a single greedy pass. This practice confounds coordination with sample multiplicity and inference compute. We synthesize nine primary empirical evaluations comprising 516 unique multi-agent configurations organized along a resource vector R with six dimensions and a baseline ladder with four categories. Against baselines with a single pass (Category A), multi-agent accuracy differences are negative overall and near zero when omitting the largest contributing study. When evaluated against baselines matched on sample count (Category B) or resource budget (Category C), multi-agent systems average -0.042 in accuracy, and multilevel random effects modeling on the log odds scale remains negative across sensitivity checks. Multi-agent accuracy equals or falls below the baseline in 74% of these comparable contrasts, and study means are nonpositive in almost all evaluated studies. Across studies reporting both baselines, moving from a greedy pass to a sampled baseline shifts accuracy differences by -0.038 on average. Because communication adds no information when agents share identical evidence, positive returns require partitioned evidence, external verification, or error diversity across models. We provide a reviewer checklist and accounting utilities.
articles.comment: 43 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. PACE Reviewer Checklist, evaluation utilities (pace CLI), and reproduction data at https://github.com/mahmoudsajjadi/pace
articles.titleCn: 更多代理、更多样本还是更多思考？解开多代理LLM中的协调、集成和测试时计算之谜
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体语言模型的评估通常将通信架构与单次贪婪搜索进行对比。这种做法将协调性与样本多样性及推理计算混淆。我们综合了九项主要实证评估，涵盖516种独特的多智能体配置，这些配置按资源向量R（六个维度）组织，并包含一个包含四类基准的基准阶梯。与单次搜索的基准（类别A）相比，多智能体准确率差异总体为负值，且在剔除最大贡献研究后接近零。当与按样本数量（类别B）或资源预算（类别C）匹配的基准进行评估时，多智能体系统的平均准确率为-0.042，对对数优势比尺的多级随机效应建模在敏感性检查中始终为负值。在这些可比对比中，74%的多智能体准确率等于或低于基准，且几乎所有评估研究的平均值均非正值。在同时报告两种基准的研究中，从贪婪搜索转向样本基准平均使准确率差异变化为-0.038。由于当智能体共享相同证据时通信不会增加信息，正向回报需要分区证据、外部验证或模型间的误差多样性。我们提供了审稿人检查清单和核算工具。

articles.title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
articles.abstract: Before an LLM agent cancels a reservation or deletes a folder for a user, what stops it from acting on a false assumption: what its tools show, or what the user says? In this work, we study this gap with presupposition theory from linguistics: an agent may act only if each claim behind the act (e.g., one reservation fits the name) is seen to hold, answered by the user, or disclosed while the act can be undone. A simple bound shows that when lookups cannot tell one record from two, any agent acts without asking first as often with two records as with one. We then vary whether a search lists, counts, or omits a second match, and whether the user states a claim that a record refutes (e.g., "It is empty"). Under a role-only prompt, a count of a second record leaves most of 36 earlier agents acting on the one they see, whereas listing both stops most. When the user says a record such as a folder is empty, however, a count of its one item stops agents about as often as a listing, and stating the claim mostly cuts acting when it is false. The newest Claude and GPT models always open a counted second record, then never act. When we add a same-name, same-zip customer to a retail benchmark, a lookup returning that customer first led to wrong-account writes in about a quarter of conversations, and one that checks a street the user knows kept completion near the one-customer level. Safe writes therefore need lookups that list or check competing records, and evaluations that vary what tools show.
articles.titleCn: 大型语言模型代理能看到什么以及用户说了什么
articles.abstractCn: 在LLM代理取消用户预订或删除用户文件夹之前，是什么阻止它基于错误假设采取行动：工具显示的内容，还是用户所说的话？在这项工作中，我们运用语言学中的预设理论来研究这一差距：只有当行动背后的每个主张（例如，一个预订符合名称）被用户确认、回答或在行动可撤销时被视为成立，代理才能采取行动。一个简单的界限表明，当查找无法区分两条记录时，代理在不询问的情况下行动的频率与一条记录时相同。然后，我们变化了搜索是否列出、计数或忽略第二条匹配项，以及用户是否声明一条记录反驳的主张（例如，“它是空的”）。在仅基于角色的提示下，第二条记录的计数导致36个先前的代理继续基于他们所见的内容行动，而列出两者则阻止了大多数代理。然而，当用户说一个文件夹等记录为空时，其一项物品的计数阻止代理的频率与列出相似，而声明该主张在为假时大多会阻止行动。最新的Claude和GPT模型始终打开计数的第二条记录，然后不再采取行动。当我们向零售基准添加一个同名同邮编的客户时，首先返回该客户的查找导致约四分之一的对话中出现错误账户写入，而检查用户熟悉的街道的查找则使完成率保持在单客户水平附近。因此，安全的写入需要列出或检查竞争记录的查找，以及变化工具显示内容的评估。

articles.title: What Do Multilingual Self-Supervised Speech Encoders Know About Sentence Meaning?
articles.abstract: Self-supervised speech models (S3Ms) have been scaled up to thousands of languages and millions of hours of audio, yet little is known about how these models structure semantic knowledge across languages. In this work, we probe sentence-level semantics in massively multilingual S3Ms across 76 languages, using linear maps from frozen speech representations into a frozen text embedding space, evaluated by cross-modal retrieval. Sentence meaning is linearly accessible but highly uneven across languages and resource tiers. Cross-lingual probes can match language-specific probes on languages never seen in probe training, but per-model monolingual decodability does not predict transfer. Within the OmniASR wav2vec family, scaling from 300M--7B disproportionately benefits high-resource languages, and ASR tuning sharply improves semantic decodability while making representations more language-specific. However, semantic content is entangled with acoustics, inflating apparent performance on single-speaker corpora.
articles.titleCn: 多语言自监督语音编码器了解句子含义吗？
articles.abstractCn: 自监督语音模型（S3Ms）已扩展到数千种语言和数百万小时的音频，但人们对这些模型如何跨语言构建语义知识知之甚少。在本工作中，我们通过将冻结的语音表征映射到冻结的文本嵌入空间，并使用跨模态检索评估，在76种语言的超多语言S3Ms中探究句子级语义。句子意义在语言和资源层级上具有线性可访问性，但分布极不均衡。跨语言探测可以在从未出现在探测训练中的语言上匹配特定语言的探测，但单模型单语解码能力并不能预测迁移效果。在OmniASR的wav2vec系列中，从30亿扩展到70亿参数的规模化显著有利于高资源语言，而语音识别调优能显著提高语义解码能力，同时使表征更具语言特异性。然而，语义内容与声学特征交织在一起，导致在单声道语料库上的表现被虚高。

articles.title: Superfluid: Local AI Server for Distributed LLM Inference
articles.abstract: Running large language models (LLMs) on local devices keeps data private, removes per-token cost, cuts network latency, and keeps working without a connection. Two shifts now strain how such models are served. On one device, several agents share a locally served model with an interactive user. Across devices, a developer or small team often owns several capable machines from different vendors, which sit idle most of the day because every local server serves one runtime on one machine. We present Superfluid, an open-source LLM server built for local inference at both scales. On one device, Superfluid drives llama.cpp, MLX, or BaseRT in isolated worker processes through one scheduler that moves interactive requests ahead of agent work, computes a prompt shared by many requests once, and writes every token to a durable log before it reaches the client. Across devices, one Superfluid server turns a fleet of machines into a single API endpoint. Machines with different hardware serve copies of the same model, receive work according to their measured speed, and can join or fail under load without losing a request. For Qwen3.8-27B on an Apple M5 Pro, a chat sent while eight agents are working receives its first token in 1.5 s, against 291-612 s on llama-server, Ollama, and mlx_lm.server. On six machines from three chip vendors serving 64 simulated users for one hour, Superfluid answers all 5,041 requests while machines join one at a time and one is killed and rejoins; throughput grows from 112 to 534 tok/s and the median first-token time falls from 99 to 12 s. On twelve Mac Studio M3 Ultras it sustains 10,656 tok/s across 38,563 requests from 384 agents without a failure. Superfluid is available under the Apache-2.0 licence at https://github.com/basecompute/superfluid.
articles.titleCn: 超流体：分布式LLM推理的本地AI服务器
articles.abstractCn: 在本地设备上运行大型语言模型（LLM）可以保护数据隐私，消除每个token的成本，减少网络延迟，并保持离线工作。目前，这种模型的部署方式面临两大转变。在一台设备上，多个代理共享本地部署的模型与交互式用户。跨设备，开发者或小团队通常拥有来自不同供应商的多台高性能机器，这些机器大部分时间处于闲置状态，因为每台本地服务器在一台机器上只运行一个运行时。我们提出了Superfluid，一个为本地推理设计的开源LLM服务器，适用于不同规模的应用。在一台设备上，Superfluid通过一个调度器驱动 llama.cpp、MLX 或 BaseRT 在隔离的工作进程中运行，该调度器将交互式请求优先于代理工作，一次性计算多个请求共享的提示，并在每个token到达客户端之前将其写入持久化日志。跨设备，一个Superfluid服务器将一群机器转变为一个API端点。不同硬件的机器提供相同模型的副本，根据其测量的速度接收工作，并在负载下加入或失效而不会丢失请求。在Apple M5 Pro上运行Qwen3.8-27B，当有八个代理工作时，发送的聊天在1.5秒内收到第一个token，而 llama-server、Ollama 和 mlx_lm.server 则需要291-612秒。在来自三家芯片供应商的六台机器上模拟64名用户一小时的服务中，Superfluid在机器逐个加入和一台被杀死并重新加入的情况下回答了所有5,041个请求；吞吐量从112 tok/s 增长到534 tok/s，中位数第一个token时间从99秒降至12秒。在十二台Mac Studio M3 Ultras上，Superfluid在384个代理发出的38,563个请求中维持了10,656 tok/s，且无故障。Superfluid在Apache-2.0许可证下提供，可在 https://github.com/basecompute/superfluid 获取。

articles.title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
articles.abstract: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. However, existing estimation schemes randomly sample the block index, so they may evaluate the same block more than once and leave some blocks unevaluated. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. We theoretically show that the proposed estimator remains unbiased while eliminating the between-group variance arising from block selection, thereby achieving lower variance than the baseline for the same sample size. In experiments on five benchmarks spanning mathematics, planning, and coding, our method achieves the highest accuracy on four benchmarks and outperforms the random block sampling baseline by an average of 12.79 points.
articles.titleCn: 一次查看每个区块：掩码扩散语言模型的减少方差后训练
articles.abstractCn: 策略梯度方法被广泛用于使大型语言模型的输出与人类偏好保持一致，但它们所需的对数似然在掩码扩散语言模型（MDLMs）中无法直接计算。因此，MDLMs 的后训练依赖于基于证据下界（ELBO）的替代目标，而近期研究通过蒙特卡洛方法估计该目标的分块变体以支持分块生成。然而，现有的估计方案会随机采样分块索引，因此可能会多次评估同一分块，而遗漏一些分块。这引入了分块选择带来的分块选择方差，从而影响了估计结果。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种全分块估计器，该估计器精确地评估每个分块一次，并对结果进行平均。我们理论上证明了所提出的估计器在消除分块选择产生的组间方差的同时保持无偏性，从而在相同样本量的情况下实现了比基线更低的方差。在涵盖数学、规划和编码的五个基准测试中，我们的方法在四个基准测试中实现了最高精度，并平均比随机分块采样基线提高了 12.79 分。

articles.title: GDP.xlsx: Benchmarking Frontier Models on Professional Workbooks
articles.abstract: We introduce GDP_xlsx, a benchmark of 70 realistic workplace requests written by professionals in 13 domains, each paired with an expert rubric of binary criteria and with the complete workbook or CSV file it refers to. Together the files hold 2.18 million populated cells, and the rubrics 791 criteria. Agents work in a container with spreadsheet tools, and an agentic judge that can open the file applies the rubric. Completeness and exclusivity criteria require set-valued answers to be found in full and with nothing extra. We rank models by strict pass@1, the share of attempts that meet every criterion. Across 20 model configurations, including frontier models from Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI, the top-scoring one, Gemini 4 Argon, passes only 38.3% of attempts, and the median score is 19.3%, leaving wide headroom. We release the evaluation harness and three public tasks; the other 67 are held out to protect the leaderboard from contamination.
articles.comment: 14 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Accepted to the Agent Evaluation Science Symposium (New York City, November 2026). Leaderboard: https://surgehq.ai/benchmarks/gdp-xlsx ; evaluation harness: https://github.com/surge-ai/gdp-xlsx ; public tasks: https://huggingface.co/datasets/surgeai/GDP.xlsx
articles.titleCn: GDP.xlsx：在专业工作簿上对前沿模型进行基准测试
articles.abstractCn: 我们介绍了GDP_xlsx，这是一个包含70个由13个领域专业人士撰写的现实工作场所请求的基准，每个请求都配有专家评级的二元标准，以及它所引用的完整工作簿或CSV文件。这些文件总共包含218万个填充单元格，评级标准包含791项。代理在带有电子表格工具的容器中工作，并且有一个能够打开文件并应用评级的代理法官。完整性和排他性标准要求集合值答案必须完整且无多余内容。我们通过严格的pass@1排名模型，即满足所有标准的尝试比例，对模型进行排序。在包括来自Google、Anthropic和OpenAI的前沿模型在内的20种模型配置中，得分最高的Gemini 4 Argon仅通过38.3%的尝试，中位数得分为19.3%，仍有很大的提升空间。我们发布了评估框架和三个公开任务；其余的67个任务被保留以防止排行榜被污染。

articles.title: Activation Steering the Nan-Shan in Typhoon
articles.abstract: Typhoon is an audiovisual installation based on Joseph Conrad's novella, in which Captain MacWhirr steers the steamer Nan-Shan directly into and through a catastrophic storm. The novella is a study of what happens when the scale of a phenomenon exceeds the practical and conceptual frameworks available to comprehend it and of the paralysis that sometimes follows a demand for action in such overwhelming circumstances. We chose the text of Typhoon to reflect on human culture's current AI moment. We prompt a large language model, seeded with Conrad's original language, to feed endlessly on its own output, and explore when and how the text becomes increasingly alien and unwieldy as time progresses, including deviations from the narrative, digressions into the model's own instructions and thinking, and long periods of incoherent rumination. We employ methods from activation steering, including a novel adaptive steering method we introduce, to control the rhythm of the narrative and the model's digressions over long stretches of generation. The simultaneous efficacy and unpredictability of this steering showcases the tension between the perceived interpretability of AI, and the reality of a system that remains outside our comprehension and control.
articles.comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Creative AI Track 2026. Website: https://stormhelm.net/
articles.titleCn: 在台风中操控南山激活
articles.abstractCn: 《台风》是一件基于约瑟夫·康拉德中篇小说的视听装置作品，其中麦克惠尔船长驾驶轮船“南山号”直接冲入并穿越一场灾难性的风暴。这部中篇小说探讨了当现象的规模超出可理解的实际和概念框架时会发生什么，以及在如此压倒性情况下行动要求有时会导致的瘫痪。我们选择《台风》的文本来反思人类文化当前的AI时刻。我们提示一个以康拉德原始语言为种子的大型语言模型，让它无休止地消耗自己的输出，并探索随着时间的推移，文本何时以及如何变得越来越陌生和难以驾驭，包括偏离叙事、偏离模型的自身指令和思考，以及长时间的混乱沉思。我们采用激活引导的方法，包括我们引入的一种新型自适应引导方法，来控制叙事节奏和模型在长时间生成过程中的偏离。这种引导的同时有效性和不可预测性展示了AI被感知的可解释性与现实之间——即一个仍然超出我们理解和控制的系统——的张力。

articles.title: LuthorSQL: A One-Pass Text-to-SQL Model as System 1 for a Slower LLM Agent
articles.abstract: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, maintains its accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit quantized weights, and transfers zero-shot to Snowflake, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB within 3.1 points of its native SQLite accuracy. Combined with Claude Opus 5.5 in a pre-registered confidence cascade over 227 questions on databases published after Opus's training cutoff, LuthorSQL answers nearly half of all questions locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy. Finally, contamination probing shows that Opus reproduces 48-92% of public benchmark gold queries verbatim without seeing the schema; however, its tool-assisted accuracy holds on renamed schemas and reaches 95.6-97.4% on post-cutoff databases. Code and data: https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql
articles.titleCn: LuthorSQL：一种作为较慢大型语言模型代理系统1的单次文本到SQL模型
articles.abstractCn: 使用工具查询数据库的前沿LLM代理是目前最精确的文本到SQL系统之一，但每次查询调用托管模型都缓慢、昂贵，并且将敏感的组织查询暴露给外部API。例如，一个每天服务10,000个查询的Claude Opus 5.5代理，按标价计算每年成本超过70,000美元。现有组织的本地硬件能在不降低代理精确性的情况下，多大程度上减轻这一负担？我们提出了LuthorSQL，这是一个非自回归的7B文本到SQL模型，它作为较慢LLM代理（系统2）的快速系统1门控，仅在不确定时才升级查询。LuthorSQL对查询计划在有限语法上预测槽分数执行单次前向传递，编译并运行最多32个候选计划，并使用训练好的验证器选择答案。仅凭LuthorSQL，在单个GPU上，它在BIRD的隐藏测试集上达到68.03%的执行精度，每个问题耗时0.84秒，在9GB的8位量化权重下保持其精度，并在3.1个点的差距内零样本迁移到Snowflake、BigQuery、MySQL、PostgreSQL和DuckDB，精度与原生SQLite相当。与Claude Opus 5.5结合，在Opus训练截止后发布的数据库上进行的227个问题的预先注册置信度级联中，LuthorSQL几乎在本地回答了所有问题的一半，同时在相同精度下将API成本降低了33.3%。最后，污染探测表明，Opus在未看到模式的情况下，逐字复现了48-92%的公共基准黄金查询；然而，其工具辅助精度在重命名模式上保持不变，并在截止后数据库上达到95.6-97.4%。代码和数据：https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql

articles.title: RAG-FGO: Dynamic Optimization of Query-Rewriting Agents for Generative RAG
articles.abstract: In retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), query rewriting serves as a core interface that aligns user intent with external knowledge bases, and its effectiveness directly determines overall system performance. However, generative retrieval faces three critical challenges in real-world deployment: noisy retrieval feedback, the difficulty of jointly optimizing discrete prompt templates and continuous decoding-control parameters, and the limited generalization of static rewriting strategies under semantically complex scenarios. To address these issues, we propose RAG-FGO, a dynamic optimization framework for generative retrieval strategies. RAG-FGO formulates query rewriting as a non-differentiable black-box optimization problem in a mixed discrete-continuous space, and represents prompt templates and decoding parameters as adaptively optimizable query-rewriting agents. The framework performs global search to enable semantic jumps and structural reorganization that escape local optima, while applying local perturbations for fine-grained alignment and precise refinement. In addition, RAG-FGO introduces an elite-preserving memory pool that accumulates high-quality strategies across iterations, thereby mitigating the impact of stochasticity and noisy feedback on optimization stability. Experimental results on a diverse suite of benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method, supporting its applicability to complex semantic retrieval tasks.
articles.titleCn: RAG-FGO：生成式RAG的查询重写代理动态优化
articles.abstractCn: 在检索增强生成（RAG）中，查询重写作为核心接口，用于将用户意图与外部知识库进行对齐，其效果直接决定了整体系统性能。然而，在现实世界部署中，生成式检索面临三个关键挑战：检索反馈噪声、联合优化离散提示模板和连续解码控制参数的困难，以及静态重写策略在语义复杂场景下泛化能力有限。为解决这些问题，我们提出了RAG-FGO，一个用于生成式检索策略的动态优化框架。RAG-FGO将查询重写表述为一个混合离散连续空间中的不可微黑盒优化问题，并将提示模板和解码参数表示为可自适应优化的查询重写代理。该框架通过全局搜索实现语义跳跃和结构重组，以跳出局部最优，同时应用局部扰动进行细粒度对齐和精确优化。此外，RAG-FGO引入了一个精英保留记忆池，在迭代过程中积累高质量策略，从而减轻随机性和噪声反馈对优化稳定性的影响。在一系列多样化的基准测试上的实验结果表明了该方法的有效性和鲁棒性，证明了其适用于复杂的语义检索任务。

articles.title: CarryOn: Learning What to Keep in Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
articles.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents can coordinate tools and applications to complete complex, multi-step tasks. As their interaction histories grow, effective context management becomes essential for reliable and efficient execution. Existing methods reduce context through summarization, pruning, or history selection. However, shorter contexts do not necessarily support better decisions: summaries can omit exact details needed for later actions, while retaining entire interactions can carry substantial irrelevant information. We propose CarryOn, a lightweight context manager that pairs compact execution state with fine-grained, source-linked evidence. A learned selector and adaptive retention policy keep relevant evidence available without additional LLM calls for context management. We introduce two complementary evaluation metrics: $S_α$ prioritizes task success while accounting for resource use, and normalized cost per success (NCS) measures the resources spent per successful task. Across AppWorld, OfficeBench, and Tau2 Telecom with three LLM Actors, CarryOn achieves 75.7% macro-averaged task success, exceeding the strongest baseline by 6.7 percentage points. It also achieves the best average scores on both metrics.
articles.titleCn: CarryOn：学习长期视野下的大语言模型代理应保留哪些上下文信息
articles.abstractCn: 长时程大语言模型代理能够协调工具和应用来完成复杂的多步骤任务。随着其交互历史的增长，有效的上下文管理对于可靠和高效的执行变得至关重要。现有方法通过摘要、剪枝或历史选择来减少上下文。然而，较短的上下文并不一定支持更好的决策：摘要可能会遗漏后期行动所需的精确细节，而保留整个交互可能会包含大量不相关的信息。我们提出了CarryOn，一个轻量级的上下文管理器，它将紧凑的执行状态与细粒度、源链接的证据相结合。一个学习到的选择器和自适应保留策略确保相关证据可用，而无需额外的LLM调用进行上下文管理。我们引入了两个互补的评估指标：$S_α$优先考虑任务成功，同时考虑资源使用情况，而每成功任务标准化成本（NCS）衡量每项成功任务所消耗的资源。在AppWorld、OfficeBench和Tau2电信三个LLM代理场景中，CarryOn实现了75.7%的宏平均任务成功率，比最强的基线高出6.7个百分点。它在两个指标上也都取得了最佳的平均分数。

articles.title: AI Reviews Are Biased Towards the Appendix
articles.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used by reviewers to highlight weaknesses during the reviewing process, and their outputs often shape the reviews that humans submit. Prior work studies how LLM reviews align with human ones, yet we know little about which parts of a paper these models actually criticize. In this work, we investigate 2,000 papers from ACL, EMNLP, COLM, and ICLR, and show that the latest GPT and Claude models draw about 50% or more of their review weaknesses from the appendix. This behavior holds across the API, coding-agent, and web access methods for using LLMs to review a paper. In contrast, we find that humans draw only 8.4% of their weaknesses from the appendix, and these weaknesses primarily revolve around a paper's presentation and content related to its core idea. Meanwhile, LLMs draw weaknesses from deep in the appendix that concern fine-grained technical details not central to the paper's contributions. We anticipate that our analysis will contribute to the scholarly discourse on AI reviews. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/cincynlp/review_appendix.
articles.titleCn: 人工智能评论倾向于附录
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在审稿过程中越来越多地被审稿人用来指出论文的不足之处，并且它们的输出往往会影响人类提交的审稿意见。以往的研究探讨了LLM审稿意见与人类审稿意见的一致性，但我们对其模型实际批评论文哪些部分知之甚少。在本工作中，我们研究了来自ACL、EMNLP、COLM和ICLR的2000篇论文，并发现最新的GPT和Claude模型约有50%或更多的审稿不足之处来自附录。这种行为在使用LLM审稿论文的API、编码代理和网页访问方法中都存在。相比之下，我们发现人类只有8.4%的不足之处来自附录，这些不足之处主要围绕论文的表述及其与核心思想相关的内容。与此同时，LLM从附录深处提取不足之处，这些不足之处涉及论文贡献非核心的细粒度技术细节。我们预计我们的分析将有助于关于AI审稿的学术讨论。我们的代码公开可在：https://github.com/cincynlp/review_appendix。

articles.title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
articles.abstract: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. Periodic manual retraining is too delayed and labor-intensive for this setting. To address these challenges, we present G-CAST, a governed continual self-training system that converts daily production evidence under evolving demand and capability contracts into reward-routed, entropy-prioritized training data and governed reward evolution. Governed checkpoint transition under cumulative evaluation controls each model update, enabling the agent to learn newly introduced behaviors without sacrificing previously accepted capabilities. Experiments on a real production e-commerce agent show that G-CAST achieves stronger adaptation to newly introduced demand while better preserving previously accepted behavior compared with a strong autonomous post-training baseline. Ablations further show that both reward-routed, entropy-prioritized data orchestration and governed reward evolution are important to these gains. G-CAST is now deployed in Yuancai(http://cai.1688.com/), a B2B procurement agent on Alibaba's 1688 platform.
articles.titleCn: G-CAST：在演变需求下对电子商务代理进行治理的持续自训练
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，越来越多的用户开始使用基于LLMs的智能体进行电子商务中的对话式购物。然而，随着新产品类别、采购场景和功能需求的不断涌现，用户需求持续变化。与此同时，产品的执行框架——包括其工具、技能和操作流程——也在不断演进，以支持日益复杂的交互。这些变化带来了两个实际挑战：1）需求漂移改变了用户请求的分布、意图和复杂性，导致一次性训练的模型逐渐落后；2）框架演进要求模型正确使用新引入的功能，同时不丢失用户已依赖的行为。在此场景下，周期性的手动再训练过于滞后且劳动密集。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了G-CAST，一个受监管的持续自训练系统，该系统在演变的供需和功能合同下，将日常生产证据转化为奖励引导、熵优先级的训练数据和受监管的奖励演进。受监管的累积评估检查点转换控制每个模型更新，使智能体能够在不牺牲先前接受的能力的情况下学习新引入的行为。在真实生产电子商务智能体上的实验表明，与强大的自主后训练基线相比，G-CAST在新引入的需求上实现了更强的适应能力，同时更好地保留了先前接受的行为。消融实验进一步表明，奖励引导、熵优先级的数据编排和受监管的奖励演进对于这些收益都很重要。G-CAST现已部署在Yuancai（http://cai.1688.com/）上，它是阿里巴巴1688平台上的一款B2B采购智能体。

articles.title: PaperCritic: Training AI Reviewers to Assess the Soundness of Papers
articles.abstract: As AI conference submissions grow rapidly, AI reviewers are being considered as an alternative. However, simply imitating human reviewing is problematic because reviewing serves multiple purposes, including evaluating papers' soundness, interestingness, and clarity, the last two of which are subjective. In this work, we focus solely on evaluating soundness, the most important and objective criterion, and define the learning objective as jointly maximizing (1) precision, based on the soundness and substantiveness of review points, and (2) recall, the coverage of high-quality reference review points. Under this problem formulation, we construct a quality-labeled review point dataset, PaperSound-23K, using 1K ICLR submissions and 23K human-written and LLM-generated review points. Using this dataset, we train an AI reviewer model, PaperCritic, through reinforcement learning with the F1 score of precision and recall as the reward. Our experiments show that PaperCritic outperforms frontier models and models trained with other AI reviewer training methods on an in-domain test set. Surprisingly, learning to review ICLR submissions also transfers to reviewing Nature-family papers and even to out-of-domain reviewing tasks (e.g., code review, legal contract review, and feedback on story writing).
articles.titleCn: PaperCritic：训练人工智能审稿人评估论文的可靠性
articles.abstractCn: 随着AI会议投稿数量快速增长，AI审稿人被视为一种替代方案。然而，单纯模仿人类审稿存在问题，因为审稿具有多重目的，包括评估论文的严谨性、趣味性和清晰度，后两者具有主观性。在本工作中，我们专注于评估最重要的客观标准——严谨性，并将学习目标定义为联合最大化（1）基于审稿点的严谨性和实质性所计算的精确度，以及（2）高质量参考审稿点的覆盖率所计算的召回率。在此问题设定下，我们使用1K ICLR投稿和23K人类撰写及LLM生成的审稿点构建了一个质量标注的审稿点数据集PaperSound-23K。利用该数据集，我们通过以精确度和召回率的F1分数为奖励的强化学习训练了一个AI审稿人模型PaperCritic。实验表明，PaperCritic在领域内测试集上优于前沿模型及其他使用AI审稿人训练方法训练的模型。令人惊讶的是，学习审阅ICLR投稿的能力也能迁移到审阅Nature系列论文，甚至迁移到跨领域审稿任务（例如代码审阅、法律合同审阅和故事写作反馈）。

articles.title: BLiMP-RO: A Benchmark of Linguistic Minimal Pairs for Romanian
articles.abstract: Evaluating grammatical knowledge in language models requires benchmarks that cover diverse linguistic phenomena and are validated against human judgments. We introduce BLiMP-RO, a Romanian minimal-pair benchmark covering 50 grammatical phenomena across ten domains. It comprises 493 linguist-constructed sentence pairs, evaluated by native speakers in five experiments, and 5,942 additional semi-automatically generated, human-validated pairs. We further investigate grammatical generalization under limited linguistic input by training GPT-2 and GPT-BERT models from scratch on Romanian BabyBabelLM data and a newly collected corpus of 10 million words from child-targeted video captions. Increasing caption training data yields approximately 9 percentage points of accuracy improvement per tenfold increase in corpus size. At matched data sizes, BabyBabelLM generally outperforms video captions, while GPT-BERT consistently outperforms GPT-2. Our findings highlight how training data quantity, composition, and model architecture shape grammatical generalization in Romanian.
articles.titleCn: BLiMP-RO：罗马尼亚语言最小对立体基准
articles.abstractCn: 评估语言模型中的语法知识需要涵盖多种语言现象并经过人类判断验证的基准。我们介绍了BLiMP-RO，一个涵盖十个领域内50种语法现象的罗马尼亚最小对语基准。该基准包含493对由语言学家构建的句子，通过五项实验由母语者评估，以及5,942对半自动生成并经人类验证的句子。我们进一步通过在罗马尼亚BabyBabelLM数据和一个新收集的包含1千万字儿童视频字幕语料库上从头训练GPT-2和GPT-BERT模型，研究了在有限语言输入下的语法泛化能力。增加字幕训练数据使每增加十倍语料库规模约提高9个百分点的准确率。在匹配的数据规模下，BabyBabelLM通常优于视频字幕，而GPT-BERT始终优于GPT-2。我们的研究揭示了训练数据数量、构成和模型架构如何影响罗马尼亚的语法泛化。

articles.title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors
articles.abstract: Abliteration, a fine-tuning-free weight edit, removes refusal from open-weight large language models (LLMs). The developer of Arbitrary-Rank Ablation (ARA), an optimisation-based variant, reports that direction-based abliteration, which ablates a refusal direction, increasingly fails on newer models. On five release pairs, refusal removal did not become uniformly harder. Qwen2.5-32B and Qwen3.8-27B, Gemma-2-27B and Gemma-4-31B, OLMo-2-32B and Olmo-3.1-32B, Mistral-Small-2409 and Mistral-Small-3.2, and Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3.5-4B were edited in Heretic 2.0 by three or four direction-based methods (difference-in-means, MPOA, SOM and, on the small pair, J-space) and ARA under the same prompts, nominal search budget, first-token KL divergence cap and selection rule; removal counted as harder when the automatic WildGuard judge found more of 972 held-out harmful prompts (JailbreakBench, XSTest, StrongREJECT, HarmBench and an author-compiled malicious-code bank) still refused. After direction-based removal, newer releases retained -1 to +37 percentage points more refusal, and after ARA -26 to +34. With run-to-run variance included, between-pair heterogeneity of the direction-based effect ranged from high to low with the scale and variance model (I^2 20-80%). ARA lost less effectiveness than direction-based methods in Gemma and OLMo and more in Qwen; each verdict rests on one ARA run, and some changed with the divergence budget or variance model. In Gemma the direction-based increase came from the malicious-code bank and reversed on public sets. Contrary to prediction, keyword counts at the tool's window did not undercount judged refusal on average, but differed by a mean 7 points per model. Audits of a single pair, method or prompt source can reach opposite conclusions. Whether a newer model resisted removal depended on the release pair, method and budget, not on generation alone.

articles.titleCn: 消融是否越来越难？并非如此：基于方向的消融和ARA在Heretic上对Qwen3.8、Gemma 4、Olmo 3.1和Mistral Small 3.2等大型语言模型及其前代的拒绝移除
articles.abstractCn: 消融，一种无需微调的权重编辑技术，可从开放权重大型语言模型（LLM）中移除拒绝行为。Arbitrary-Rank Ablation（ARA）的开发者，一种基于优化的变体，报告称基于方向的消融，即消融拒绝方向，在新型模型上逐渐失效。在五个发布对中，拒绝移除并未变得普遍困难。Qwen2.5-32B和Qwen3.8-27B、Gemma-2-27B和Gemma-4-31B、OLMo-2-32B和Olmo-3.1-32B、Mistral-Small-2409和Mistral-Small-3.2，以及Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen3.5-4B在Heretic 2.0中通过三种或四种基于方向的方法（均值差异、MPOA、SOM，在小对中为J空间）和ARA在相同提示、名义搜索预算、首标KL发散上限和选择规则下进行编辑；当自动WildGuard裁判发现更多972个保留的有害提示（JailbreakBench、XSTest、StrongREJECT、HarmBench和一个作者编译的恶意代码库）仍然拒绝时，移除被视为更困难。基于方向的移除后，新型发布保留了-1到+37个百分点的拒绝，而ARA后为-26到+34。包含运行间方差后，基于方向效应的对间异质性随规模和方差模型（I^2 20-80%）从高到低变化。在Gemma和OLMo中，ARA的失效程度低于基于方向的方法，而在Qwen中更高；每个判断基于一次ARA运行，且一些判断会随发散预算或方差模型变化。在Gemma中，基于方向的增加来自恶意代码库，并在公共数据集上逆转。与预测相反，工具窗口的关键词计数并未平均低估判断的拒绝，但每个模型平均差异7点。对单个对、方法或提示源的审计可能得出相反结论。新型模型是否抵抗移除取决于发布对、方法和预算，而不仅取决于生成。

articles.title: UltraBERT-JEV: Encoder models for System One Applications
articles.abstract: We study encoder models that pick one of several options in a single forward pass, without generating text. This technical report compares recipes for fine-tuning UltraBERT-380M with one mask per option. The four recipes differ in how an option is scored and how the scores become probabilities; one follows the expert gate of DeepSeek-V3. Trained on the same data as Qwen3-0.6B with the LLM-as-Jev recipe (67.6% test accuracy), the encoder reaches 69.7% to 72.1%. Scoring an option by "yes" minus "no" instead of "yes" alone gives the larger gain, from 69.7% to 71.3% on the test set and from 57.8% to 59.6% on external benchmarks (56.1% for the decoder). Sigmoid normalisation adds 0.8 test points; a square-root softplus adds none. One request at a time on an NVIDIA A100, the encoder takes 29 ms per decision against 68 ms, but uses more peak memory (2.8 against 2.2 GiB). An auxiliary head, trained on human-marked evidence and on labels selected with a reward adapted from SelfCite, predicts in the same pass the sentences annotated as support for the answer.
articles.titleCn: UltraBERT-JEV：系统一应用中的编码器模型
articles.abstractCn: 我们研究了一种编码器模型，该模型在单次前向传递中选择多个选项之一，而无需生成文本。本技术报告比较了使用每个选项一个掩码微调UltraBERT-380M的几种方法。这四种方法在如何对选项进行评分以及如何将评分转换为概率方面有所不同；其中一种方法遵循DeepSeek-V3的专家门。在与其他LLM-as-Jev方法（与Qwen3-0.6B使用相同的数据，测试准确率为67.6%）相同的数据上进行训练，该编码器的准确率达到了69.7%至72.1%。通过使用"是"减去"否"而不是单独使用"是"来评分选项，可以获得更大的提升，在测试集上从69.7%提高到71.3%，在外部基准测试上从57.8%提高到59.6%（解码器的基准测试准确率为56.1%）。Sigmoid归一化增加了0.8个测试点；平方根软plus没有增加。在NVIDIA A100上一次请求一个，该编码器每项决策需要29毫秒，而其他方法需要68毫秒，但使用了更多的峰值内存（2.8 GiB对2.2 GiB）。一个辅助头，通过在人类标记的证据和用SelfCite调整的奖励选择的标签上进行训练，可以在同一传递中预测被标记为支持答案的句子。

articles.title: Delayed Effects of Temporary Weight Decay in Muon Pretraining
articles.abstract: A temporary optimization intervention can increase validation loss when it ends yet reduce it at the final training budget. We demonstrate this with temporary weight decay in Muon-trained decoder-only Transformers with 162M, 405M, 1.4B, and 3.4B parameters. For models up to 1.4B parameters, moving a fixed-duration decay window from early to late training reverses its final effect. At 162M, changing window duration alters final loss even at approximately matched total shrinkage. Most strikingly, a schedule selected at 162M and transferred without retuning to 1.4B is 0.26 nats worse than no decay when removed, overtakes it only after 73% of training, and ultimately finishes 0.028 nats better while also outperforming the best sampled constant-decay baseline. Early decay leaves a persistent weight-norm deficit, which keeps relative steps larger after the intervention ends. An approximate norm-dynamics recurrence captures the slow convergence of these relative steps, and fixed-norm replays of the measured trajectories reproduce the performance ordering and a similar loss difference. At 162M and 405M, norm-reset experiments show that smaller weight norms at the end of the decay window explain most of the final loss improvement. A separate Gram intervention exhibits related post-removal norm and relative-step dynamics. These results show that temporary optimization schedules can have delayed effects long after removal and should therefore be evaluated at the intended final training budget, not only at removal.
articles.titleCn: μ子预训练中临时权重衰减的延迟效应
articles.abstractCn: 临时优化干预在结束时可能会增加验证损失，但在最终训练预算下会减少损失。我们通过在参数量为1.62亿、4.05亿、14亿和34亿参数的Muon训练的仅解码器Transformer模型中实施临时权重衰减来证明这一点。对于参数量不超过14亿模型的实验表明，将固定时长的衰减窗口从早期训练移动到后期训练会逆转其最终效果。在1.62亿参数模型中，改变窗口时长即使在总收缩量大致匹配的情况下也会改变最终损失。最引人注目的是，在1.62亿参数模型中选择并未经重新调整直接转移到14亿参数模型的衰减计划，在移除时比无衰减情况差0.26纳特，直到训练的73%后才超越无衰减情况，最终以0.028纳特的微弱优势完成，并且也优于最佳的恒定衰减基线。早期衰减会留下持续的权重范数缺陷，这导致干预结束后相对步长仍然较大。一个近似的范数动力学递归关系可以捕捉这些相对步长的缓慢收敛，而固定范数的重放测量轨迹可以重现性能排序和相似的损失差异。在1.62亿和4.05亿参数模型中，范数重置实验表明，衰减窗口结束时的较小权重范数解释了最终损失的大部分改进。一个独立的Gram干预措施表现出相关的移除后范数和相对步长动力学。这些结果表明，临时优化计划在移除后可能产生延迟效果，因此应在预期的最终训练预算下进行评估，而不仅仅是在移除时评估。

articles.title: Securing Multi-Agent Systems by Design
articles.abstract: Multi-agent systems solve complex tasks by decomposing them into subtasks, delegating the subtasks to agents, and aggregating the agents' responses using an aggregation rule. Malicious agents can manipulate the final solution by providing malicious responses to their assigned subtasks. In this paper, we first propose response manipulation attacks (ReMA), which iteratively optimize malicious responses to maximize attack effectiveness. Specifically, we formulate untargeted and targeted attacks as optimization problems and develop an approach to approximately solve these problems by iteratively refining malicious responses based on feedback from a surrogate multi-agent system. To defend against such attacks, we further propose SecMAS, a secure aggregation rule that leverages the semantic similarities among agent responses to select the response that is most consistent with a sufficiently large subset of the other responses. We theoretically establish security guarantees for SecMAS against both untargeted and targeted attacks. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that existing aggregation rules are vulnerable to ReMA, whereas SecMAS effectively defends against all evaluated attacks, including adaptive variants of ReMA, while maintaining utility comparable to that of existing aggregation rules.
articles.titleCn: 通过设计保障多智能体系统安全
articles.abstractCn: 多智能体系统通过将复杂任务分解为子任务，将子任务分配给智能体，并使用聚合规则聚合智能体的响应来解决复杂任务。恶意智能体可以通过向其分配的子任务提供恶意响应来操纵最终解决方案。在本文中，我们首先提出了响应操纵攻击（ReMA），该攻击通过迭代优化恶意响应来最大化攻击效果。具体而言，我们将非目标攻击和目标攻击建模为优化问题，并开发了一种方法，通过迭代地根据替代多智能体系统的反馈来细化恶意响应，从而近似地解决这些问题。为了防御此类攻击，我们进一步提出了SecMAS，这是一种安全聚合规则，该规则利用智能体响应之间的语义相似性来选择与其他响应中足够大的子集最一致的响应。我们理论上为SecMAS针对非目标攻击和目标攻击建立了安全保证。广泛的评估表明，现有的聚合规则容易受到ReMA的攻击，而SecMAS在保持与现有聚合规则相当的有效性的同时，有效地防御了所有评估的攻击，包括ReMA的适应性变体。

articles.title: AmbiSteer: Selectively Eliciting Ambiguity-Aware Responses in Vision-Language Models
articles.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often exhibit overconfidence, providing firm answers even when visual evidence is insufficient. A prominent case is referential ambiguity in Visual Question Answering (VQA), where multiple entities in an image are plausible referents of a question. Addressing such cases requires recognizing when ambiguity is present: ambiguous questions can be handled by asking for clarification or enumerating plausible referents, while unambiguous questions should receive a direct answer. Current VLMs struggle with this distinction, often defaulting to a single interpretation. To investigate whether activation steering can serve as an inference-time mechanism to elicit such behaviors, we introduce AmbiSteer, a lightweight framework to selectively elicit ambiguity-aware behavior. Across three VLMs, we find that steering alone has limited and model-dependent effects, while prompting is generally more effective. Combining prompting and steering substantially increases clarification and enumeration behaviors, but also elicits them on unambiguous cases. AmbiSteer addresses this using a linear classifier to predict input ambiguity and condition the steering direction accordingly, increasing the proportion of inputs handled appropriately from 59.0% to 77.0% on average across models. Our work sets the ground for lightweight approaches to reduce model overconfidence in uncertain multimodal settings.
articles.titleCn: AmbiSteer：在视觉语言模型中选择性诱导歧义感知响应
articles.abstractCn: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）常常表现出过度自信，即使视觉证据不足时也会给出肯定的答案。一个突出的案例是视觉问答（VQA）中的指代歧义，即图像中的多个实体都可能成为问题的指代对象。处理这类情况需要识别何时存在歧义：歧义性问题可以通过请求澄清或列举可能的指代对象来处理，而明确性问题则应直接给出答案。当前的VLMs难以区分这种情况，往往默认采用单一解释。为了探究激活引导是否可以作为推理时机制来引出此类行为，我们引入了AmbiSteer，一个轻量级的框架，用于选择性引出具有歧义感知的行为。在三个VLMs上，我们发现单独引导的效果有限且依赖于模型，而提示通常更有效。结合提示和引导可以显著增加澄清和列举行为，但也可能在不明确的情况下引出这些行为。AmbiSteer通过线性分类器预测输入的歧义性，并据此调整引导方向，从而将模型在各个模型上适当处理输入的比例从59.0%提高到77.0%。我们的工作为在不确定的多模态环境中减少模型过度自信的轻量级方法奠定了基础。
